      "name": "NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt",

      "effect_on_target": "Its negation denies classical scalar advection satisfaction at speed 1 and (x,t) = (0,1).",

      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "NumStability.IsRectangleConservationLawSolution",
      "interpretation": "Requires integrability on every finite spatial slice and every finite temporal endpoint-flux slice, and equates spatial mass at t minus spatial mass at s with the time integral of left-minus-right endpoint flux for every a,b,s,t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts a time-integrated rectangle balance for the specified scalar step with identity flux. It does not assert a time derivative of spatial mass.",
      "source_match": "Preserves arbitrary spatial endpoints and flux orientation. Equivalence to the ordinary time derivative displayed in (1.10) is not established for discontinuous solutions; the target explicitly denies that derivative at one endpoint-crossing time.",

    },
    {
      "id": "D003",

      "status": "fail"
    },
    {
